info.title: Physical Book Reading Tracker API
info.description: REST API for tracking physical book reading. Authenticate via POST /api/v1/auth/login; state-changing requests require the header `X-Requested-With: fetch`.

post.description: Columns: student_id, full_name, username (required); email, gender, generation, class (optional). Use dryRun to validate only. Nothing is created unless every row is valid.
Students create PENDING entries; administrators create APPROVED entries.
